description: Start here when the person asks you to work on a site's SEO, to use SEO Skill, or what to do next. Where the site is in the SEO loop and the one step that is due, with its instructions, its first jobs (pages with Google Analytics key events from Organic Search first, then the conversion pages in the business context) and the call that marks each done. The steps: write the business context (when there is none, or it is more than 90 days old), unblock pages (crawl and Google index problems), improve the pages that rank (quick wins, low click-through rates, striking distance), then find new pages for buying searches and earn links. It runs the issues checks when the list is more than a day old. Do the step, then call it again. With context: saves the business context the first step asks for, replacing the old one, then returns the next step.

autopilot.description: Optional. true returns the steps to put the site on autopilot, a scheduled run of the agent, with the prompt each run starts with, instead of the due step. Only after the person has said yes.

context.description: Optional. The business context to save, as Markdown under the headings the context step gives. Only after the person has seen it.

saved.description: Optional: an issues list saved in the person's project before, such as .seo/issues.json, to carry over its marks once. This server keeps the list from then on.

site.description: Search Console property or site, such as sc-domain:example.com, https://example.com/ or example.com.

name: seo_next
title: What to do next
